title: MVP: peeku Core+CLI+MCP (v1)
description: Implement PRD in prd.md: library-first C# API + CLI + MCP tools (1:1).
design: Single source of truth via ToolDescriptors (prd.md §6). Core: IpeekuClient + models (§1). CLI: System.CommandLine + Serilog (§2). UIA: FlaUI (§0). Capture: Windows.Graphics.Capture + CsWinRT (§0/§1). MCP: official C# SDK (§0/§3/§4).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] CLI command set matches prd.md §2 (doctor/windows/capture/uia/actions/observe/wait/batch)
- [ ] MCP tools mirror CLI 1:1 with inputSchema+outputSchema per prd.md §4
- [ ] Schema parity test(s) prevent drift (prd.md §6)
notes:
PRD coverage map
- §0 deps/constraints: peeku-uaq.2
- §1 Core API + models: peeku-uaq.3
- §2 CLI surface: peeku-uaq.11
  - windows list/focused: peeku-uaq.5
  - capture image: peeku-uaq.6
  - uia snapshot (+ selector/refId): peeku-uaq.7
  - see/find/element get: peeku-uaq.8
  - actions: peeku-uaq.9
  - observe/wait/batch: peeku-uaq.10
- §3–§5 MCP tools/schemas/response shape: peeku-uaq.12
- §6 single source of truth + parity tests: peeku-uaq.4
- §7 docs/examples (selector DSL v1, refId stability): peeku-uaq.13

- peeku_capture_image: peeku-uaq.6
- peeku_uia_snapshot: peeku-uaq.7

title: Scaffold .NET solution (Core/Cli/Mcp)
description: Create dotnet solution + project layout per prd.md §1/§2/§3.
acceptance_criteria: dotnet build passes; basic entrypoints exist (peeku, peeku-mcp).

title: Observe + wait + batch
description: Implement ObserveAsync (bounded long-poll), WaitAsync, BatchAsync per prd.md §1/§2/§4.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Observe: target + events filter + duration (default 10s) + maxEvents (default 200); returns events[] (prd.md §2/§4 peeku_observe)
- [ ] Wait: selector + target + timeout; returns found + elementRef (+ optional final snapshot) (prd.md §2/§4 peeku_wait)
- [ ] Batch: ops from file; stopOnError; returns per-op results w/ tool, ok, durationMs (prd.md §2/§4 peeku_batch)

title: CLI: System.CommandLine surface + pretty/json output
description: Implement peeku CLI per prd.md §2: global opts, command index, Serilog logging.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Global opts per prd.md §2: format, timeout, log-level, log-file, trace-id, profile
- [ ] Commands per prd.md §2 implemented: doctor/windows/capture/uia/see/find/element/actions/observe/wait/batch
- [ ] `--format json` stable for scripting; `pretty` for humans

title: MCP server: tools + schemas + response shape
description: Implement peeku MCP server per prd.md §3–§5. Tools mirror CLI 1:1; structuredContent + text fallback; image blocks for capture.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Tools mirror prd.md §4 list (doctor/windows/capture/uia/see/find/element/actions/observe/wait/batch)
- [ ] inputSchema + outputSchema match prd.md §4; results include structuredContent + text JSON (prd.md §5)
- [ ] Capture/see optionally include image content blocks (base64 PNG)

title: Docs/examples: usage + selector DSL v1
description: Write minimal docs: CLI examples, MCP tool list, selector DSL v1 (BNF/examples) + refId stability notes (prd.md §7).
acceptance_criteria: README covers install/usage; selector grammar documented; example sessions included.

title: Vet + pin deps (WGC/FlaUI/System.CommandLine/Serilog/MCP SDK)
description: Confirm maintained libs, versions, licensing, Windows build constraints. Record decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Dependencies selected + pinned; rationale captured; no incompatible licensing.

title: peeku.Core: IpeekuClient + request/response models
description: Implement canonical tool-shaped API per prd.md §1 (+ shared types §1.3).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] IpeekuClient implements all methods in prd.md §1 (Doctor/Windows/Capture/UIA/Actions/Observe/Wait/Batch)
- [ ] Request/response models cover shared types (§1.3) + result envelope (meta/ok/error)
- [ ] All results include traceId; errors include stable code + message

title: Single source of truth: ToolDescriptors + schema snapshot tests
description: Implement ToolDescriptor registry (prd.md §6). Ensure CLI and MCP stay 1:1.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Tool list defined once (name/title/desc + inputSchema + outputSchema + handler)
- [ ] Schema snapshot/parity tests: CLI opts == MCP inputSchema; required flags match; tool names match (prd.md §6)

title: Window discovery: windows_list + windows_focused
description: Implement window enumeration + focus detection per prd.md §2/§4 tools peeku_windows_list/_focused.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `peeku windows list`: supports titleContains/processName/limit (default 50) per prd.md §2
- [ ] Output includes hwndHex,title,processId,processName (prd.md §4 peeku_windows_list)
- [ ] `peeku windows focused`: returns focused window hwndHex + processId (+ title/processName when available)

title: Capture: capture_image (Windows.Graphics.Capture)
description: Implement capture pipeline per prd.md §0/§1 + tool peeku_capture_image schema (§4).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Target support: desktop|focused|screen:n|hwnd:HEX|query:JSON (prd.md §2/§4 Target)
- [ ] `--out` optional; if omitted writes temp and returns imagePath (prd.md §2)
- [ ] Output: imagePath,mimeType,width,height (+ base64 when includeBase64=true) (prd.md §4 peeku_capture_image)

title: UIA: snapshot + selector + element refs (FlaUI)
description: Implement UiaSnapshotAsync + selector resolution + ElementRef strategy per prd.md §1/§2/§4.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `peeku uia snapshot`: depth (default 6), maxNodes (default 5000), includeProperties basic|all (prd.md §2)
- [ ] Output: snapshotId, root, elements[] (flattened) (prd.md §4 peeku_uia_snapshot)
- [ ] Selector expr + preferCachedSnapshot supported (prd.md §1.3/§4 Selector)
- [ ] ElementRef/refId strategy documented + implemented (prd.md §1.3)

title: UIA: see/find/element_get
description: Implement SeeAsync (capture+snapshot), FindAsync, ElementGetAsync per prd.md §2 + §4 tools.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `peeku see`: returns image metadata + snapshotId + elements (prd.md §2/§4 peeku_see)
- [ ] `peeku find`: selector + optional target (default focused) + limit (default 20); returns matches w/ elementRef+rect+score (prd.md §2/§4 peeku_find)
- [ ] `peeku element get`: by refId or selector; returns element + properties + patterns + rect (prd.md §2/§4 peeku_element_get)

title: Actions: click/invoke/set_value/type/scroll/hotkey
description: Implement action methods using UIA patterns (FlaUI) per prd.md §2 + §4.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Selection: refId or selector (+ optional target) for all actions (prd.md §2)
- [ ] Click supports method auto|uia|input; output includes methodUsed (prd.md §2/§4 peeku_click)
- [ ] Type supports append (default true) + delayMs; scroll supports delta or lines + direction; hotkey parses keys string (prd.md §2/§4)
- [ ] All action tools return ok+traceId (+ structured error on failure)
